headlines.title: British American Tobacco vs Altria: Which High-Yield Dividend Stock Is the Better Buy
headlines.summary: Altria and British American Tobacco both flood retirement accounts with cash, but the tobacco giant pulling ahead on growth, valuation, and smokeless momentum is not the one with 60 consecutive dividend raises.

headlines.title: How a Roth IRA Can Keep Thousands More of Your High-Yield Dividend Income Compounding
headlines.summary: Where you hold a high-yield dividend stock matters almost as much as which one you pick, and for ordinary-income payers like BDCs and REITs, the wrong account quietly erodes a portion of every distribution before it ever compounds.

headlines.title: Altria Group Inc's Dividend Analysis
headlines.summary: This article first appeared on GuruFocus.  Altria Group Inc (NYSE:MO) recently announced a total dividend of $1.11 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-09-15.  This payout includes a $1.11 per share cash dividend payable on 2026-10-09.

description: Altria Group, Inc., through its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells smokeable and oral tobacco products in the United States. It offers cigarettes primarily under the Marlboro brand; large cigars and pipe tobacco under the Black & Mild brand; moist smokeless tobacco and oral tobacco products under the Copenhagen, Skoal, Red Seal, and Husky brands; oral nicotine pouches under the on! brand; and e-vapor products under the NJOY ACE brand. The company sells its products to distributors, as well as large retail organizations, such as chain stores. Altria Group, Inc. was founded in 1822 and is headquartered in Richmond, Virginia.
